title: "DIY-QuantiFluorONE-dsDNA-Fluorometer Workshop Booklet"
---

## About this booklet

This English-language booklet supports the practical workshop use of the DIY-QuantiFluorONE-dsDNA-Fluorometer. It is intentionally compact and assumes that participants already have basic laboratory experience.

The active structure contains 13 chapters and one appendix section. Detailed topics from the former 25-chapter scaffold have been consolidated to avoid repetition and an unnecessarily fragmented workflow.

## Current content status

Chapters 3–8 contain the current developed material. Chapters 1–2 and 9–13 are concise, intentional draft or planning pages that define the remaining scope without duplicating the old scaffold.

> **Validation notice:** software stability, documentation maturity, hardware maturity, and analytical validation are controlled separately. The complete analytical procedure is not yet finally validated.
